name: Tuna Tossed Salad with Avocado, Artichoke, Tomato, Cucumber & Croutons

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ lemon
½ English cucumber
1 tomato
1 avocado
1 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the parsley. Add mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp pure maple syrup
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl.
Drain tuna and flake with a fork. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and cooled croutons, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (120 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
